rationale: Goods line matches PO and receipt exactly (150 EACH @ $18.00), so no price or quantity variance (clauses 3, 4). The $380.00 expedited freight line is a permitted non-PO charge: contract clause 6.2 expressly allows pass-through of expedited carrier charges up to $500.00, and the receipt note confirms production requested overnight delivery (policy clause 6). Recomputed tax at 7.5% on $3,080.00 is $231.00, matching the invoice exactly (clause 5). No credit memos or prior invoices; net payable $3,311.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
